OFD.name: OFD
OFD.note: Same valve as OVNT (Jaksa 2/2 cryo solenoid)

assumptions.vent_gas: Nitrogen; the FullFlow config identifies nitrogen as the pressurant.
assumptions.vent_process: Adiabatic ideal-gas blowdown to ambient through the valve CdA; no piping restriction, heat transfer, or two-phase flow.
assumptions.drain_process: Incompressible LOX discharge to ambient at the listed fixed ullage gauge pressures; no flashing, piping restriction, or outlet back-pressure.
assumptions.fill_process: Incompressible LOX fill through the fixed LFS path, OQD-location component, and OFD in series, to a tank held at the listed fixed ullage gauge pressure. LFS supply pressure is the 250 psig value reported by the LOX Fill GFSSP Sim; it is not derived from any OFD value. ground_fill_path_cda_mm2 is that page's 0.00429 in2 (2.7677 mm2) LFS Fill System CdA. The script uses these fixed LFS inputs and solves only for the OFD CdA needed to reach each configured fill-time target. The selected OQD-location component is Swagelok SS-45S8, which the manufacturer identifies as a 1/2 in 40-series manual ball valve (not a quick disconnect) with water Cv 12. Its water-equivalent CdA is 203.91 mm2 using the script's catalog bridge CdA = Cv / 0.05885. This is only a flow-restriction approximation: its published standard cleaning, PTFE packing, and room-temperature pressure rating do not establish LOX compatibility or cryogenic pressure rating. chilldown_and_boiloff_delay_s is a separate configurable first-pass delay, not a valve restriction. Hydrostatic pressure of the rising liquid column is included. No other hose, QD, line, vent, heat-leak, flashing, or back-pressure restrictions are included.
assumptions.fill_delay_calibration: The 48 min Elytra reference corresponds to about 0.0658 kg/s for its 418 lbm 90% fill. Applying that average liquid-transfer rate to the 14.398 kg Hopper 90% fill gives 218.7 s of liquid transfer; the remaining 2661.3 s is modeled as the configurable conditioning delay.
assumptions.tank_inside_diameter_in: FullFlow notes 8.5 in OD. This isolated drain model uses 8.5 in as an unverified effective ID.
